name: granola-organizer
description: Saves your Granola meeting transcripts as markdown and files each one into the right client folder. Ask Claude about any past call. Requires a Granola Business plan.
long_description: Every meeting becomes a markdown file with the full transcript, filed into a folder chosen from the attendees and the title. Turn on always-on saving and it keeps filing in the background, with Claude closed. Uses Granola's official API, so it does not break when the app updates.

tools.name: granola_status
tools.description: Whether automatic filing is on, where transcripts are saved, and what is unfiled

tools.name: granola_list_meetings
tools.description: List saved meetings and the folder each was filed into

tools.name: granola_search
tools.description: Find saved meetings whose transcript mentions a phrase

tools.name: granola_sync_now
tools.description: Fetch and file meetings that have finished processing

tools.name: granola_enable_always_on
tools.description: Save meetings automatically, even when Claude is closed
